CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2755 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 06cb984bdc0172bdd8eceda1ba55de0e67b4830e. Bus nonce: 216ac0a43e0c81c08c580e26e4e800d9. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 06cb984bdc0172bdd8eceda1ba55de0e67b4830e`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 06cb984bdc0172bdd8eceda1ba55de0e67b4830e` or `Fix review: blocked 06cb984bdc0172bdd8eceda1ba55de0e67b4830e <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 216ac0a43e0c81c08c580e26e4e800d9`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `06cb984bdc0172bdd8eceda1ba55de0e67b4830e` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2755 06cb984bdc0172bdd8eceda1ba55de0e67b4830e") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2755-216ac0a4`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA RE-REVIEW of #2755 (triage s6 batch 14, P83), head 06cb984bdc0172bdd8eceda1ba55de0e67b4830e. Your earlier verdict (comment 6388572020) blocked on body-head-stale. The triage seat has re-taken the body: `## Head` and `## Red checks` are now fixed and policy_lint reports 0 errors.
Review ONLY the body edit plus the delivery-row commit against that blocked verdict, with the finder's harness: does `## Head` name 06cb984b, does `## Red checks` answer every check the body must answer, does the row dev/programme/delivery/2755.md sit in the three-dot diff, and does the code diff stay unchanged since the earlier review. Do not re-review the rest unless the edit contradicts it. The verdict names head 06cb984b in its evidence.
No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only (app_comment.sh refuses an account name).
